cases.name: normal-static-template-inventory
cases.scenario: 读取全部固定版本默认模板并建立版式、槽位、元素、token 和静态文件清单
cases.observed: 16 templates, 383 layouts, 1600 component slots, 444 merged-component groups, 10283 nested elements, 1002 static asset files; source hashes are recorded.

cases.name: edge-missing-page-type-and-applicability
cases.scenario: 检查版式是否声明页面类型、适用条件与模板继承字段
cases.observed: Default template JSON has no explicit page-type or per-layout applicability field; page-type labels are keyword-derived candidates. No parent/extends field is declared; merged variants are not treated as inheritance.

cases.name: failure-template-render-and-export
cases.scenario: 通过已选模板生成内容并渲染/导出，以观察真实容量与视觉结果
cases.observed: No template generation request, model call, PPTX export, or visual review was attempted in this task. The existing P03-02/03 reports record configured=false and an HTTP 428 login-setup gate.

limitation: Static inventory verifies the pinned files and source model only. It does not establish runtime schema behavior, real text capacity, overflow handling, visual fidelity, or PPTX export behavior.
remaining: After authentication/provider setup is authorized, run normal, edge, and failure template cases and capture layout assignments and traces.
Export representative PPTX output and inspect rendered pages for geometry, overflow, token application, and asset resolution.
Update template applicability and capacity observations only from reproducible runtime evidence.
